failures.issue: Both lines use a visibly heavier weight than the other item titles and regular body text. Neither is a button or selected tab, so the type rule does not permit this emphasis.

across_options.issue: Type weight changes: C makes the jacket title and offered amount heavier than A and B. This is a typography change beyond D3 spacing (brand/ledger.md D3; brand/constitution.md Art. 14.4).

The item photos are not held constant. The jacket folds, hanger and crop change; the shoes change arrangement and crop; the lamp framing changes. These alter visual salience independently of spacing (brand/constitution.md Art. 14.4).

State-fill hue and saturation change, especially the Live pill: A is vivid turquoise-green, while B and C are softer greens. Sold and the money highlight also vary. These are color changes beyond D3 (brand/ledger.md A1 and D3).

The field artwork changes in color distribution and mesh-line pattern. C also widens the field relative to the item rows and changes the Accept/Counter width proportions; A and B keep the field on the photo column’s start edge. Gap changes belong to D3, but the artwork and control proportions introduce additional variables (brand/constitution.md Art. 14.4).
